isabelle.backend.command.description: Command used to launch the Scala Isabelle VS Code backend. Empty uses ISABELLE_VSCODE_SERVER or isabelle-vscode-server from PATH.

isabelle.backend.args.description: Arguments passed to the Scala Isabelle VS Code backend command.

isabelle.backend.cwd.description: Working directory for the Scala backend. Empty uses the first workspace folder.

isabelle.backend.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for backend protocol requests.

isabelle.backend.maxHeapMb.description: Maximum JVM heap (in MB) passed to the Scala backend as `-Xmx<N>m`. Default `0` means do NOT pass `-Xmx`, so the JVM's ergonomic defaults (typically 25% of system RAM, capped) apply. Bump to 4096 for typical PIDE document checks against `HOL`, or 8192+ when working in large AFP entries. Takes effect on the next backend restart (reload the window after changing).

isabelle.pide.prewarmOnActivation.description: When `true`, the extension warms up an Isabelle/PIDE `Headless.Session` for the active session right after activation so the first `Isabelle: Show PIDE Document Status` call returns instantly. Power-user opt-in — the warmup costs 5-30 s of CPU and ~2-4 GB of heap on first activation. Default `false` so users who never touch PIDE features pay nothing.

isabelle.executablePath.description: Path to the Isabelle executable used by the backend for CLI-backed milestone commands.

isabelle.languageServer.enabled.description: Explicit override for whether `isabelle vscode_server` runs as a language server. Leave at the default (unset) and the extension auto-starts the server when Isabelle is detected (see `isabelle.languageServer.autoStart`). Set to `true` to force-start regardless of detection, or `false` to keep the LSP off even when Isabelle is reachable. Requires Isabelle 2019 or newer.

isabelle.languageServer.autoStart.description: When `isabelle.languageServer.enabled` has not been explicitly set, automatically start the Isabelle language server if the activation-time prerequisite check finds a working Java 21+ runtime and a reachable Isabelle 2019+. A failed auto-start is remembered per resolved Isabelle runtime so the extension does not retry indefinitely; changing `isabelle.executablePath` or `isabelle.languageServer.extraArgs` clears the flag. Set this to `false` to require an explicit `isabelle.languageServer.enabled` toggle for every install.

isabelle.languageServer.extraArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to `isabelle vscode_server` before the protocol switches (e.g., `["-L", "./isabelle.log"]`).

isabelle.languageServer.logVerbose.description: When true, the language client logs full LSP traffic to its output channel (helpful for debugging; noisy).

isabelle.session.roots.description: Additional workspace-relative directories to scan for Isabelle ROOT files.

isabelle.session.afpPath.description: Optional path to an AFP checkout for future session discovery.

isabelle.session.active.description: Active Isabelle session for the current workspace.

isabelle.build.extraArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to `isabelle build` before the active session name.

isabelle.sledgehammer.provers.description: Optional space-separated list of Sledgehammer provers (e.g. `cvc5 verit z3 e spass vampire zipperposition`). Empty falls back to the prover list reported by `isabelle vscode_server` via `PIDE/sledgehammer_provers_response`, which in turn falls back to Isabelle's own `sledgehammer_provers` defaults. Only consulted when the LSP relay is enabled and a Sledgehammer run is dispatched through `PIDE/sledgehammer_request`. The setting is also exposed for future Scala-backend wiring.

isabelle.sledgehammer.isar.description: When true, ask Sledgehammer to return Isar-style structured proofs (`proof ... qed`) instead of one-liners. Mirrors the `isar` flag of `PIDE/sledgehammer_request`. Default `false` matches the upstream `isabelle vscode_server` default.

isabelle.sledgehammer.try0.description: When true, allow Sledgehammer to try the standard `try0` tactics (`auto`, `blast`, `fast`, `force`, ...) before and around the external provers. Mirrors the `try0` flag of `PIDE/sledgehammer_request`. Default `true` matches the upstream `isabelle vscode_server` default.

isabelle.sledgehammer.quiescenceDelayMs.description: Optional quiescence delay (in milliseconds) the panel enforces before dispatching `PIDE/sledgehammer_request` in LSP mode, applied as `max(0, delay - timeSinceLastEdit)` so the wait only happens when a recent edit means the language server may still be reprocessing the theory. Set higher (for example 3000-5000) if you reproducibly see `<error_message>Unknown proof context</error_message>` from the server; set to 0 to disable and dispatch immediately. The setting has no effect when the LSP relay is not in use.

isabelle.repair.aiProvider.description: Optional id of a registered AI repair provider that the `Isabelle: Request AI Repair Suggestion` command will delegate to. Empty (the default) means no provider is selected; the command refuses to call anything until both this setting and `isabelle.repair.aiAcknowledgedSharing` are set. No provider ships with the extension by default — see docs/AI_REPAIR.md for the registration contract.

isabelle.repair.aiAcknowledgedSharing.description: Safety gate for the AI repair seam. When false (the default), the `Isabelle: Request AI Repair Suggestion` command refuses to invoke any registered provider, even if `isabelle.repair.aiProvider` is set. Setting this to true acknowledges that the provider will receive the full checked-repair request, which may include source code, diagnostics, and proof state — read docs/AI_REPAIR.md before enabling.

isabelle.proofState.autoUpdate.description: When true (the upstream default), the LSP-mode proof state panel re-renders on every `Session.Commands_Changed` or `Session.Caret_Focus` server event. When false, the panel only refreshes when you run `Isabelle: Refresh Proof State` (or use the panel toolbar refresh button). Maps onto the upstream `PIDE/state_auto_update` notification.

isabelle.proofState.margin.description: Pretty-printer margin (in columns) for the LSP-mode proof state panel. Lower values produce more line breaks; higher values keep formulas on one line. Maps onto the upstream `PIDE/state_set_margin` notification.

isabelle.dynamicOutput.margin.description: Pretty-printer margin (in columns) for the caret-driven dynamic output sub-panel shown beneath the proof state. Maps onto the upstream `PIDE/output_set_margin` notification.

isabelle.setup.suppressNotifications.description: When true, the extension stops surfacing the activation-time onboarding toast for missing Java / Isabelle prerequisites. The `Isabelle: Check Setup Prerequisites` command still works on demand. Defaults to workspace scope so dismissing it in one project does not silence it everywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Isabelle PIDE
walkthroughs.description: Install the runtime prerequisites, open a theory, and verify the extension is wired to your Isabelle installation.

steps.title: Install Java 21+
steps.description: The bundled Scala backend runs as a fat jar. Any Java 21+ runtime works.

steps.title: Install Isabelle 2019+
steps.description: Install Isabelle and either put `isabelle` on `PATH` or point the `isabelle.executablePath` setting at it.

steps.title: Open a .thy theory file
steps.description: The extension activates on Isabelle theory files. Open one to wake up the panels and commands.

steps.title: Try `Isabelle: Build Active Session`
steps.description: End-to-end check: pick a session and run an Isabelle CLI build to confirm everything is wired up.

scripts.test:integration: npm run bundle && npm run test:integration:compile && node ./out/test/integration/runTest.js
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm run test:integration
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run bundle && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('backend/dist/isabelle-vscode-server.jar')){console.error('Missing backend/dist/isabelle-vscode-server.jar. Run \"npm run backend:package\" first (requires Java + sbt).');process.exit(1);}"
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run backend:package && vsce package --no-dependencies --out isabelle-pide-vscode.vsix
scripts.package:validate: npm run check && npm run backend:package && vsce ls --no-dependencies && vsce package --no-dependencies --out isabelle-pide-vscode.validation.vsix && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('isabelle-pide-vscode.validation.vsix',{force:true})"
scripts.backend:package: cd backend && sbt -batch -Dsbt.supershell=false -Dsbt.log.noformat=true assembly && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('backend/dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('backend/dist',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('backend/target/isabelle-vscode-server.jar','backend/dist/isabelle-vscode-server.jar')" && node backend/scripts/check-license.js
